hints.title: Core Insight
hints.text: Check whether the total sum of all digits is even, returning zero immediately if the parity is odd.

hints.title: Algorithmic Structure
hints.text: Both even and odd positions must separately sum to half the total sum while having fixed slot counts (n // 2 odd slots and (n + 1) // 2 even slots).

hints.title: State Transitions
hints.text: Iterate across unique digit values from 0 to 9, choosing how many instances of each digit go into odd slots using combinations.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Evaluates in optimal O(10 * n * S) runtime.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Brute-force exhaustive search exceeds the time limit.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Uses O(10 * n * S) auxiliary memory for optimal state tracking.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identifies optimal pattern to achieve O(10 * n * S) complexity.
